Written 2026-10-24T00:07Z by an isolated contract-review subagent of `domain:skills` seat 2. Inputs: card #25507 (the maintainer's words of 2026-10-23 16:43–16:44Z and Wanted 1–4), claim 6370029859 and addendum 6370094728, `git diff origin/main...2ab989f1aa` (origin/main `19d3720af1` read 2026-10-23T23:58Z), the head's check-runs (read 2026-10-24T00:06Z), `contract-review.md` and `review-checklist.md` on `main`. The PR body's self-assessment was not an input to the judgments; its three quick-read watch points (a) (b) (c) were read and are judged under ③.

### ① Derived judgments

**Wanted 1 — 「业务理由」 on every card (`filing-gate.md`).** L24 「POST 前正文答四件:类别、业务理由、动手的读者(哪席哪步)、查重查询与命中数(含已关)」 and L25 「业务理由:谁受益、什么场景、不做会怎样;③ 以原话代,④ 承父单;分诊 ⛔ 不代写」 carry the field and its three parts as the card words them (who benefits / scenario / cost of not doing). Seat-filed and audit-filed cards are not exempted anywhere; ③ answers with the maintainer's own words and ④ inherits the parent, which is the only sensible reading for those two classes. PASS.

**Wanted 2 — the 分诊席 judges it.** `lanes/triage.md` L5 scope now reads 「每张卡首触(业务理由与定级)」; `triage-duties.md` L34 points at 「四答、理由判据」 in `filing-gate.md` and L35 orders the read 「首触先按业务理由三出口分流,再定级路由」. The three exits in `filing-gate.md` L26–L28 match the card exactly: clear and on the North-Star direction ⇒ 照常定级入队; missing or not holding ⇒ `Triage: returned` 退回立卡人, 留 `finding`, re-read after the body changes, 「⛔ 不代写不关卡」 (the card stays open — the ⛔ the card and claim both demand: the 分诊席 never closes a card on business grounds); product trade-off or unclear direction ⇒ `needs-user-decision` 入箱, 总监席呈批, 「⛔ 不替维护者判需求」 (that inbox is 「待决策汇总」). Audit batches: L29 「批量立卡(一次 ≥10 张):审计评论带 `Batch-of:` 行,总监席每源抽 ≤5 张呈维护者过目」 — a sample, not every card. The pre-existing close path L31 (「补不齐(四类皆非)者才因缺件首触即关 not_planned」) is untouched and closes on category, not on business grounds. `Triage: returned` is read by `check-half-states.mjs`'s `isTriageRulingComment` on the `Triage:` prefix, so it counts as the audit comment the other new lines require. PASS.

**Wanted 3 — premise check before dispatch (`dispatch-runbook.md`).** L150–L153 under the renamed heading 「派发前置:前提核实,再把本地检出钉到 main」: a read-only subagent at the floor tier, for a card-thread card run 「在交候选给 coordinator 之前」; 「成立 ⇒ 派;不成立而改法明确 ⇒ 改卡再派;判不了 ⇒ 入决策箱,⛔ 不占卡线程槽」; 「改法明确 = 目标不变,只换落点或修法:评论记原前提、读数与改法,再改正文」 (the comment the card asks for); and 「砍范围、降级、关卡是卡的命运,归人工地板 ⛔ 不借改卡裁;读数落认领 `Premise:` 行」. The three exits and the no-slot rule are the proposal's words 「核实成立就派;不成立、但改法明确的,就改卡后再派;判断不了的,转决策,不占卡线程名额」 as the maintainer answered them with 「立卡」 and 「并且立刻派发」. PASS.

**Wanted 4 — the human floor.** `triage-duties.md` L75–L103 on this head are byte-identical to `origin/main` (`diff` of the two ranges is empty); the floor proper begins L78 「裁决恒归维护者人工」 and runs through the 人工地板 / 风险判据 / 工作量判据 / 不呈 / 例外一二 / 请示纪律 lines to L103. 「必须人工决裁」 (`lanes/director.md` L22) is untouched. The new lines point at the floor rather than restating it: runbook L154 「归人工地板」, `filing-gate.md` L27 「⛔ 不代写不关卡」 and L28 「⛔ 不替维护者判需求」. No ruling path is reopened to a seat: every new exit ends in the queue, the filer, or the decision inbox. PASS.

**The addendum — 「而且分诊应该所有卡都分诊,因为有的车道在立卡的时候就打上了标签。」** The rewrite of PR #25422's line 「有 `domain:*` 无 pm-state,或有 `pm:queue`+`domain:*` 无 `priority:*` 的半标卡,归所属车道席补齐」 into 析取 ③ and ④ on the triage seat (`triage-duties.md` L14–L15, with ②'s two-minute window; runbook L64 「析取①②③④」) is exactly what that word requires: a half-labelled card is a lane-labelled card, and the word puts every such card through triage. 析取 ④ returns with the same definition it had before #25422 (`pm:queue` + `domain:*`, no `priority:*`). The rest of #25422's thin-triage settlement is intact on this head: `lanes/triage.md` L4 「只写标签与审计评论,⛔ 无 PR、无认领」, two repos 「objectstack、objectui」, 「应用仓无分诊席」, one seat and the fire cadence (L6–L7) — none silently reversed. The supporting lines are in scope and consistent: `SKILL.md` L172 「预贴标签只是建议,队列与级别只由分诊落笔(例外一同承);无分诊审计评论 ⛔ 不得认领」; `execution-duties.md` L9 「无分诊审计评论的卡不是候选,预贴 `pm:queue` 视同无;例外一的 sub-issue 承父卡首触」; `lanes/skills.md` L22–L23 withdraw the lane's self-triage (both remaining 「自分诊」 hits on the tree are ⛔ lines); `triage-duties.md` L74 「每张卡欠一次分诊首触,车道 ⛔ 不自分诊」; `cross-repo-coordination.md` L10 extends a single-lane seat's first touch to 「含 `finding` 与业务理由,判据评论同分诊」. 

**FAIL-1 — the fully pre-labelled card has no finder.** `triage-duties.md` L17 「预贴标签只是建议:`pm:queue`/`priority:*` 与建卡同分钟 ⇒ 视作未分诊首触;⛔ 不凭 actor」 states the rule for the card the maintainer's sentence is about, but no sweep population lists that card: a card filed with `domain:*` + `pm:queue` + `priority:*` in the same minute matches none of 析取 ①–④ (① needs no labels, ② no `domain:*`, ③ no pm-state, ④ no `priority:*`), and the line this one replaces on `main` carried the finder 「窗内新建」 that the rewrite dropped. `execution-duties.md` L9 and `SKILL.md` L172 refuse the card as a candidate for want of an audit comment, so under this head such a card is neither triaged nor claimable until a human notices — the opposite of 「所有卡都分诊」. One in-place fix, net 0 lines, 115 bytes, no ceiling move: rewrite L17 to 「- 预贴标签只是建议:`pm:queue`/`priority:*` 与建卡同分钟 ⇒ 入析取①照首触;⛔ 不凭 actor。」 (or any wording that names which sweep population carries it). Fixable by the card thread on this branch; the record is re-rendered on the new head.

**Budgets and surface.** Every touched rule file is at or under its ceiling row on this head: `SKILL.md` 318/318, `filing-gate.md` 68/68 (was 64), `triage-duties.md` 103/103, `dispatch-runbook.md` 245/245 (was 241), `execution-duties.md` 188/188, `lanes/triage.md` 7/7, `lanes/skills.md` 32/33, `cross-repo-coordination.md` 51/51. The widest added line is 120 bytes (`filing-gate.md` L24); none exceeds 120. No login appears in any added line. Ratchet exit 0 (self-test 164 cases; cross-file moves 3; total ceilings down 488), id-lint exit 0 (87 files clean), frame-sync and frame-freshness exit 0, governed-prose exit 0. The file surface is the claim's plus the addendum's three files, with one deviation recorded under ③ (SKILL.md). No Tier H path is touched: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the nine paths returns `.claude/**` ×8 as the only register hits (Tier S) and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` as off-register; size 73 lines, under the 3000-line lift.

**Merge.** The head is a merge commit whose second parent is current `origin/main` (`19d3720af1`); `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 2ab989f1aa` is conflict-free, and the merge commit's tree equals `git merge-tree` of its two parents (`1ff3c6c988…`), so the merge reproduces. Against `origin/main` the diff is exactly the nine files, +51/−22.

**Check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-24T00:06Z):** 50 check runs, all completed — 32 `success`, 18 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 pending. Both required jobs are `success` (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`), as are `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `Check Changeset`, and `Test Core` 1/6–6/6. Green across the board; the verdict below fails on rule content, not on CI.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched (`.claude/**` and one `scripts/pm/**` gate); `skip-changeset` is the right form for this repository and the label is on the PR. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are correct: rule text and two ceiling integers widen no accept set and no public surface. PASS.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Same-account review (the ③ note for a PR whose author is not the reviewing account's own).** PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay `pr_create`); the body's attribution `github_login` is `os-elon-musk`, the same account as `Reviewed-by-account:` below. Under `contract-review.md` this record is therefore a review, not by itself the Tier S landing record; the ① substitute under the interim line is the maintainer's standing Tier S word for this seat (2026-10-23 14:14Z, 「后续按 pm-dispatch 规则审核通过的都可以落地」). Nothing here flips, queues or arms the PR.
- **Watch point (a), judged:** the rewrite of #25422's 半标卡 line is required by the 16:44:57Z word and reverses nothing else of #25422 (see ①). Agreed, not a silent override.
- **Watch point (b), judged:** the `SKILL.md` 例外二 withdrawn is L172 (self-labelled ⇒ direct claim), not the `triage-duties.md` 例外二 kept by director batch #3 item 1.2 (L92–L93, byte-identical). Agreed. Surface deviation noted: the claim admits `SKILL.md` 「only if a line is paid in the same file」, and this edit is a rule change, not a payment; the addendum did not name it. The word makes the withdrawal unavoidable (an exception that lets a lane skip triage contradicts 「所有卡都分诊」) and the body declares it, so this is recorded, not failed; the seat should add a one-line claim addendum naming `SKILL.md` L172 so the in-flight file-surface check reads true.
- **Watch point (c), for the maintainer:** single-lane repos (`hotcrm`, `cloud`, `objectos`, …) have no 分诊席 (#25422), so `cross-repo-coordination.md` L10 has the `repo:*` seat read the business rationale in its own first touch — filer and judge can be the same seat there. That is the consequence of 「应用仓无分诊席」, outside this card's scope; widening the 分诊席 to app repos would be its own card.
- **Ceiling raises are a floor class.** `filing-gate.md` 64 → 68 and `dispatch-runbook.md` 241 → 245 are 「抬上限」, a human-floor item under ruling 6356061991; they rest on the maintainer's words of the day (「立卡」, 「并且立刻派发」) quoted in the rows and on the standing Tier S word. Named so the maintainer sees it, as the floor asks.
- **`Premise:` claim line** is prescribed in the runbook but not yet in the `SKILL.md` claim template (318/318); the claim-reading checkers read only `Branch:` / `Clause-②:` / `Metadata-protocol:` / `Container & model:`, so an extra line is legal; one-line follow-up when `SKILL.md` next has a line to pay.
- **PR body vs head:** every line count and ceiling in the body matches this head; acceptance greps reproduce (「例外二」 one hit at `triage-duties.md` L92; 「自分诊」 two ⛔ hits). One imprecision: the body says the `main` merge 「changes none of the nine files」 — the merge brings `main`'s #25474/#25506 hunks into `dispatch-runbook.md` and `execution-duties.md`, two of the nine; the PR's own diff against `main` is unchanged by it. The body's first line is the project attribution HTML comment, declared as a deviation.
- **Overlap with card #25490 (queued).** This PR edits `cross-repo-coordination.md` L10 only and leaves `seat-post-protocol.md` and `seat-lifecycle.md` untouched. Of #25490's six items, two are made moot by this head: `seat-lifecycle.md` L76 「析取④」 (the disjunct exists again with its pre-#25422 meaning) and `cross-repo-coordination.md` L7 「中央分诊是 `domain:*`/type/定级的唯一生产者」 (true again once ③④ return to triage and 「队列与级别只由分诊落笔」). Four remain for #25490: `seat-post-protocol.md` L28 (liveness → 总监席 digest) and L80 (「主仓归分诊座位」), `seat-lifecycle.md` L39 (「由分诊一笔中继释放」), and the `check-half-states.mjs` prescription string. #25490's body should be re-read before dispatch — the premise check this PR prescribes.
- Dev-side open questions: none flagged in the PR body beyond the items above.

- `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L64: 「sweep 析取①–⑤ = `list_issues` + `since`」

Line budget unchanged: `triage-duties.md` 103/103, `dispatch-runbook.md` 245/245; L78–103 of `triage-duties.md` still byte-identical to `main`.
